🔁 Redo ready 📚 List · being kind to yourself · 8 slides “things that make sense only after a really heavy week” 📝 Slides
1. things that make sense only after a really heavy week 2. going to bed at nine with the kitchen light still on isn't giving up. you are just saving some strength for tomorrow. 3. the pile of clean laundry sitting on the chair all week is not a failure. you just needed the sleep more than an empty room. 4. saying 'i don't know yet' out loud stops you from pacing the hallway at midnight. 5. sitting on the bathroom rug with the door locked for five minutes is how you find a quiet room when the house is too loud. 6. letting the phone ring on your kitchen counter doesn't mean you are a bad friend. you just have nothing left to say tonight. 7. you do not have to fix your whole life on a wednesday night. you just have to wash your face and turn off the light. 8. save this for the quiet nights when you forget how much you are carrying.
✍️ Caption
you spent all week carrying everything at once. you do not have to solve the next five years before tomorrow morning. save this for a night when you need some grace. #selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself
